teach_overlay.scale: Willem Kolff replaced two million microscopic Bowman's capsules with forty metres of butcher's sausage skin wrapped round a wooden drum — using tiny pores in cellulose that let small urea poison molecules slip out into salt water while holding every red blood cell inside
